name: Skill Points
intro: Skill points unlock skills in the skill trees. You get one each time your character levels up.

sections.heading: How You Get Them
paragraphs: You get 1 skill point each time your character levels up. Leveling a discipline, such as [Pyromancy](discipline:pyromancy), gives no skill points.

sections.heading: How You Spend Them
paragraphs: Each skill costs 1 skill point. You can unlock it once you reach the level its skill tree shows for it. Click the skill again to get the point back.

evidence: Run progression2, build 24464547: each character level up added 1 to Skill Points.
Runs grants1 and progression3, build 24464547: discipline level ups left Skill Points unchanged.
Run passives1, build 24464547: unlocking a skill took 1 skill point, and pressing it again returned it.

name: Proficiency Points
intro: Proficiency points buy passives. Each discipline has its own, which you get by leveling that discipline.

sections.heading: How You Get Them
paragraphs: Each time a discipline levels up, you get proficiency points for that discipline.

sections.heading: How You Spend Them
paragraphs: A passive costs points of its own discipline. A passive with ranks costs more for each rank you buy. Lasting Servitude costs 2 points for its first rank, then 4, 6, 8 and 10, so all five ranks cost 30.
Each discipline page lists what every rank of its passives costs.

evidence: Run grants1, build 24464547: a discipline level up added 1 proficiency point of that discipline, Necromancy 2, and Focuses, whose level the game names Staff, and Vampirism none after the first.
Run passives1, build 24464547: Lasting Servitude's ranks cost 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 points, and Lingering Souls' 1 to 5.

name: Blood Levels
intro: Blood Levels is a video setting that changes how much blood you see and how many [Blood Magic](discipline:blood-magic) points you get. To change it, open Settings from the pause menu and choose Video and Effect Settings.

sections.heading: Blood Magic Points
paragraphs: Each time Blood Magic levels up, your Blood Magic points are set to the number for your setting. They replace the points you had, so points you saved are lost.

sections.heading: Getting the Most Points
paragraphs: Set Blood Levels to BLOODBATH before Blood Magic levels up, and spend your points before its next level.

evidence: Run rowgate1, build 24464547: with the settings window set to No blood, A bit of blood, Default Amount and BLOODBATH, the next Blood Magic level up left 2, 3, 4 and 6 points, and after spending 2 of 3 points a level up restored 3.
Code: Blood Magic Level Tracking sets the points to the game instance's Blood Level plus 1, which SettingsWindow1's Blood selection writes.
